name: Philemon
lede: The fifty-seventh book of the Bible, in full: Paul's letter from his bonds at Rome to Philemon and the church in his house at Colossæ, sent with Onesimus — I beseech thee for my child, whom I have begotten in my bonds; no longer as a servant, but more than a servant, a brother beloved; receive him as myself; put that to mine account; I Paul write it with mine own hand, I will repay it; prepare me also a lodging, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: More Than a Servant
books.blurb: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy, to Philemon, to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow-soldier, and to the church in thy house; the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through thee; for love's sake I rather beseech, being such a one as Paul the aged; I beseech thee for my child Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds, once unprofitable, now profitable — my very heart; no longer as a servant, but more than a servant, a brother beloved; receive him as myself; if he oweth thee aught, put that to mine account: I Paul write it with mine own hand, I will repay it; prepare me also a lodging; Epaphras, Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, Luke.
